local_tax_note: Many Iowa school districts levy a local income surtax, typically 1%-20% of your Iowa state tax liability (not of wages directly) — varies by district and not computed here.
deviation_note: This is an estimate based on standard single-filer federal, FICA, and IA state calculations. Actual withholding may differ based on your W-4 elections, pre-tax deductions, and other factors.
